name: xmlElemNew
description: Creates an XML document object element

params.name: xmlObj
params.description: Name of the XML document object in which you are creating the element

params.name: namespace_or_childName
params.description: URI of the namespace to which this element belongs or the name of the element to create.

params.name: childName
params.description: The name of the element to create. This element becomes a child element of xmlObj in the tree.
